tensurafragments.skill.gambit_cards.desc: §oThrow cards that stick where they land. Warp to them, or blow them up — just not in your own face.
tensurafragments.skill.shikigami_control: §oPaper and a little magic. Breathe life into stone, fold paper into beasts and see through their eyes, bind a barrier, and let a paper doll take the blow meant for you.

tensurafragments.skill.rainbow_talismans: §oTensura's spells and spirits, reborn in every colour at once. Each one burns, freezes, shocks and crushes in a single rainbow strike.

tensurafragments.skill.flame_emperor.des: §oSovereign of every flame. Command all of Tensura's fire magic, and when that isn't enough, call down the Draconic Hell Storm.

tensurafragments.skill.spirit_control.de: §oEvery blow calls a spirit. Ifrit, Sylphide, Undine, the War Gnome and the Blade Tiger answer in turn, strike once, and are gone.

tensurafragments.skill.energy_magic.desc: §oPour your life's experience into a spell. Tensura's magic, burning green with twice the power, paid for in levels instead of magicules.
tensurafragments.energy.no_levels: Not enough levels: this spell needs %s
tensurafragments.skill.soul_reaper.descr: §oEvery life you take leaves its soul in your hands. Call the dead back to fight for you, devour their power, or pour them into the living to make them yours.

tensurafragments.race.lesser_spirit.desc: A newborn spirit of the Spirit Realm. It has no body of its own: it may cross into the material world for a short while, and must possess a weakened creature before its time runs out or fade away.
tensurafragments.race.greater_spirit.des: A spirit grown strong enough to choose what it will become. Its next evolution binds it to one element.
tensurafragments.race.heroic_spirit.desc: An element spirit awakened as a True Hero. Holy power shields it and its spirit burns with divine ki.
tensurafragments.race.demonic_spirit.des: An element spirit awakened as a True Demon Lord. Darkness cannot touch it, and it drains the life of all it touches.
item.tensurafragments.book_of_passage.to: Spirits only: cross from the Spirit Realm to the material world (or back).
tensurafragments.spirit_race.not_spirit: Only a spirit can read the Book of Passage
tensurafragments.spirit_race.crossed: You cross into the material world. Possess a weakened creature within %s minutes, or your spirit will fade.
tensurafragments.spirit_race.anchored: Your spirit has taken a body. You may stay in the material world.
tensurafragments.spirit_race.fading: Your spirit is fading: %s seconds left to take a body
tensurafragments.spirit_race.hud: Spirit fades in %s:%s · possess a body

%1$s faded back into the Spirit Realm
tensurafragments.race.flame_spirit.descr: A spirit bound to flame, burning and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.race.water_spirit.descr: A spirit bound to water, flowing and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.race.wind_spirit.descri: A spirit bound to wind, rushing and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.race.earth_spirit.descr: A spirit bound to earth, unshakable and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.race.light_spirit.descr: A spirit bound to light, radiant and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.race.darkness_spirit.de: A spirit bound to darkness, shadowed and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.race.space_spirit.descr: A spirit bound to space, boundless and whole. It can become its element at will and shrugs off attacks of its own kind.
tensurafragments.skill.spirit_release.de: §oA spirit wearing a body need not be held to it. Unleash your own spirit's power through the flesh, wrapped in a blue aura, for as long as the body can bear it.
